subject: Pilot thresholds, SLOs and cost targets — Acceleron
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@acceleron.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.s@acceleron.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot thresholds, SLOs and cost targets — Acceleron

Hi Samir + Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before we kick off the pilot: 

High-level objective:
- Validate the Acceleron search assistant integration at 50 qps sustained, 200 qps peak for bursty periods, under target latency and cost constraints.

Proposed success criteria (first pass):
- Latency: P50 < 60ms, P95 < 220ms for 1k token responses (realistic median payload).
- Throughput: 50 sustained qps, 200 peak qps with <5% error rate.
- Cost: target <= $0.0035 per token (model + infra) for production configuration; staging can be higher.
- Quality: intent recall >= 92% on the 1k-case test set; hallucination rate <= 1.5% measured by the annotated prompt set.

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Redwood to provide: baseline perf runs (latency/throughput) on sample workload, draft evaluation harness, and suggested quantization/config profiles (owner: Vivek).
- Acceleron to provide: representative request traces, acceptance prompt set (owner: Samir), and expected traffic profile for pilot (owner: Priya).
- Joint tasks: define measurement window, instrumentation hooks, and SLIs (owners: Ben + Neha).

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange artifacts and instrumentation checklist.
- Week 1: Redwood baseline runs + first pass cost estimate.
- Week 2: Integration smoke tests and initial QA; collect metrics.
- Week 3: Finalized run with gating metrics and go/no-go review.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-outline.pdf (pilot plan + instrumentation checklist). I’ve also added links to a shared Drive doc in the HubSpot record.

Please confirm owners and the numbers above or tell me where to adjust. If those targets look reasonable, we’ll schedule a 30-min alignment on Thursday to finalize the measurement window.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions (Redwood Inference)
---
redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Samir Rao <samir@acceleron.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@acceleron.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot thresholds, SLOs and cost targets — Acceleron

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the concise plan. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Throughput: the 50 qps sustained target is fine, but can we define sustained as 10-minute rolling average? That’s what our infra monitors currently report.
- Latency: our production SLA for user-facing interactions today is P95 < 300ms. We can try to hit your P95 < 220ms target during the pilot but would like to mark that as stretch unless our trace set shows lower median tokens.
- Cost: $0.0035/token looks promising. Can you provide an initial cost breakdown (model type, quantization, infra estimate) so finance can pre-approve?
- Quality: we’ll share a 500-prompt acceptance set by Friday. One note — some prompts will be multi-turn; does your harness handle conversation-level evaluation or only single-turn?

Owners confirmed on Acceleron side: Samir (evaluation set + success criteria), Priya (traffic profile + ops contact). We prefer the Week 1 baseline runs to run against a staging dataset that mirrors production diversity.

If we’re aligned, I’ll accept the Drive invite and we can lock the Thursday slot.

Best,
Samir Rao
VP Product — Conversational Suite
Acceleron, Inc.
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@acceleron.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.s@acceleron.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot thresholds, SLOs and cost targets — Acceleron

Samir — thanks, good points. Short replies inline: 

- Sustained definition: yes, let’s use 10-minute rolling average for sustained qps. I’ll update the doc.
- Latency: we’ll treat P95 < 220ms as the target for the pilot acceptance gate but mark it as "stretch". P50 target stays at <60ms. We’ll report both.
- Cost breakdown: attached initial costing-estimate-v1.csv with model variant and infra assumptions + a short note on quantization tradeoffs. Ben and Neha will run the baseline and surface the sensitivity analysis.
- Multi-turn evaluation: our harness supports conversation-level traces; we’ll ask for conversation IDs in the acceptance set. Please include expected turn lengths distribution.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Acceleron: upload acceptance prompt set + turn-length histogram by Fri 2026-12-04 (owner: Samir).
- Acceleron: provide traffic profile + staging env access (owner: Priya) by Mon 2026-12-06.
- Redwood: run baseline perf & cost estimate against provided traces (owner: Ben) by Mon 2026-12-07.
- Redwood: instrumentation checklist + eval harness link (owner: Neha) by Mon 2026-12-07.
- Joint: Thursday 12/3 11:00am PT alignment meeting to confirm measurement windows (I’ll send calendar invite).

I’ve attached the costing CSV and added a short pilot outline to Drive. If any of the dates are infeasible, call them out and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — Vivek
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@acceleron.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.s@acceleron.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot thresholds, SLOs and cost targets — Acceleron

Internal note + short status update for the thread: 

Ben has the perf harness queued; he’ll start runs against the sample traces as soon as we get the csv + traces from Acceleron. We’ll run the following sweep: 
- Model variants: base fp16, 8-bit quantized, 4-bit QAT candidate.
- Batch profiles: single-request, 8-request batching, 32-request batching (to simulate burst coalescing).
- Measurement windows: 10m rolling and 1m peak.

Preliminary ETA: initial baseline numbers by Mon 12/07 (end of day). I’ll post the results to the Drive link and summarize gating metrics in the meeting.

Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@acceleron.ai>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@acceleron.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot thresholds, SLOs and cost targets — Acceleron

All good from our side — we uploaded the 500-prompt acceptance set and the turn-length histogram to the Drive folder and granted staging access for the IP range noted in the doc. We’ll take the Thursday call to review the initial numbers and decide on the go/no-go criteria.

Two quick asks before the meeting: 
1) Can Redwood include a simple per-call cost sensitivity table (delta cost for 4-bit vs 8-bit vs fp16) in your baseline notes? That will help our Finance team.
2) For quality metrics, please include the exact annotation rubric you’ll use to measure hallucination rate so our QA can spot-check.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Samir
